topic_thesis: Viral news claiming a mandatory 0.4% tax on UPI payments over ₹2,000 is pure clickbait fearmongering—the Finance Ministry's strict Zero-MDR mandate guarantees bank-to-bank UPI remains 100% free for consumers.
strategic_angle: Expose how sensational headlines intentionally confuse backend merchant PPI wallet interchange fees with regular UPI transfers, while callously ignoring how payment apps secretly slip in ₹1–₹3 'convenience platform fees' under your nose.
key_statistic: 0.4% fake tax myth vs ₹0 statutory consumer fee on UPI
target_emotion: Cynical relief combined with anger towards clickbait financial media and sneaky app fees
pinned_comment_text: Did you panic seeing headlines about a '0.4% UPI tax' over ₹2000? Have apps like PhonePe or Paytm quietly charged you ₹1-₹3 'platform fees' instead? Comment 'UPI' and we will DM you the Finance Ministry's official zero-charge guidelines! 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Address the Tamil daily scanner demographic who rely on GPay and PhonePe for everything from tea stalls to grocery runs. Expose the 'UPI Tax WhatsApp Forward' using Tanglish terms like 'Fake News Panic', 'Zero-MDR Mandate Rules', and 'App Platform Fee Trick'. Show the exact math showing bank-to-bank UPI is zero rupees.
source_signal: Viral clickbait panic around 0.4% UPI transaction tax & Finance Ministry Zero-MDR clarification
